_comment: Grounding reference for the four major palm lines (Notion spec §4). One source of truth: pasted into the Gemini prompt AND used to build local templated fallback readings. Traditional palmistry — entertainment content, not a factual claim.

lines.label: Life line
lines.position: Curves around the base of the thumb (Mount of Venus), from between thumb and index finger down to the wrist.
lines.governs: Vitality, energy, major life changes, general wellbeing — not lifespan.

variations.text: Strong vitality and resilience; you recover fast from setbacks.
Life is shaped more by other people's energy than your own drive — not a sign of a short life.
Lower physical stamina; you do better with rhythm and rest than with intensity.
Warm, generous, physically energetic, loves travel and open spaces.
Cautious with energy; prefers home, routine and a small trusted circle.
A sharp turning point — a move, career switch or major life reset.
A stretch of scattered energy and stress; needs deliberate recovery time.
Extra protection and support; someone or something reliably backs you up.
Ambition and periods of clear personal growth.
Energy leaks into obligations; watch for burnout phases.
Restlessness in later life — travel, relocation, or a second chapter.

lines.label: Head line
lines.position: Runs horizontally across the middle of the palm, starting near the life line's origin.

variations.text: Thorough thinker; you turn ideas over completely before deciding.
Quick, practical, decisive — you'd rather act than analyse.
Logical, structured, realistic; strong with systems and numbers.
Creative and imaginative; ideas arrive sideways rather than in straight lines.
Excellent focus and memory.
A wandering mind; thrives on variety, struggles with long single tasks.
Attention shifts often; best in short bursts of deep work.
A mental turning point — a change of belief, field of study or worldview.
Balances logic and imagination; good at explaining complex things simply.

variations.match: Joined to life line at the start
variations.text: Careful and family-influenced early on; builds confidence gradually.

variations.match: Separated from life line at the start
variations.text: Independent and self-directed from a young age; takes risks early.

lines.label: Heart line
lines.position: Uppermost horizontal line, below the fingers, from one edge toward the index/middle finger.

variations.text: Idealistic in love; high standards and a clear picture of the right partner.
Follows attraction and instinct; can be self-focused in relationships.
Guards feelings closely; shows love through actions rather than words.
Intense, loyal, all-in emotional attachment.
Emotionally reserved; needs time and safety before opening up.
Practical about love; values stability over intensity.
Expressive and openly affectionate; makes the first move.
A significant heartbreak or emotional turning point.
Emotional ups and downs; several meaningful relationships.
Balances head and heart well; a good and fair partner.
Warm and sociable; friendships come easily.

lines.label: Fate line
lines.position: Vertical line rising from near the wrist toward the middle finger (may be absent).
lines.governs: Career, life direction, external influences, purpose.

variations.text: A clear sense of direction; career path set early and followed steadily.
Direction is still forming; you're free to define it yourself.
Life is self-authored rather than fixed — freedom over a set path.
Ambition shows up early; you knew what you wanted young.
Success built on your own effort and self-reliance.

variations.match: Starting from the mount below the little finger
variations.text: Other people — family, mentors, partners — shape your path strongly.
A career change or reinvention, then a stronger second run.
Several shifts of direction before settling.
Two parallel tracks — a job plus a serious side pursuit.
A decision around mid-life redirects the career.
A relationship or emotional choice reshapes the path.
